purpose: HMRC Income Tax liabilities statistics (15 July 2026) Table 2.5 Income Tax payers by range of total income: the 2023-24 outturn and HMRC's 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 projections for the eleven published bands and the all-ranges total. Consumed by the SPI count-row uprating applier (hmrc.itl_2026.taxpayer_count_growth_by_total_income_band), which moves each SPI 2023-24 count band by the calendar-year window of the two overlapping tax years over 2023-24 in the Table 2.5 band that contains it.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
